minutes.headline: Select Board approved acting police lieutenant, then held a policy workshop reviewing the manual with no votes.
minutes.summary: After a closed session on solar litigation, the board announced a Green Communities grant award event, approved minutes and warrants, and appointed an acting police lieutenant and acting sergeant. Most of the meeting was a policy workshop reading through the board's policy manual and flagging items for later revision. No policy changes were voted.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved an acting police lieutenant appointment; the vote on an acting sergeant was not audible and was moved to next week's agenda.
The acting sergeant appointment was missing from the agenda, so the board agreed to act on it at next week's meeting.
Most of the meeting was a policy workshop that flagged items in the policy manual; revisions and votes were left to later meetings.
Members raised changes to the free cash policy and a new policy on reducing future OPEB liability, with no vote taken.
The board announced that the Green Communities grant award would be made public on Friday, after the town's application.

why_it_matters: The flagged free cash and OPEB policies govern how town savings are spent and how long-term retiree benefit costs are handled, which bear on future tax bills; nothing changed at this meeting.
A Green Communities grant would pay for energy projects that would otherwise fall on the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: The acting sergeant appointment, set for next week's Select Board meeting.
Later meetings where the flagged policies are revised and voted.
